name: Chanjet TPlus GetStoreWarehouseByStore - Remote Command Execution
author: SleepingBag945
description: Changjet Tplus has a front-end remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker can use the GetStoreWarehouseByStore method to inject a serialized payload and execute arbitrary commands. This ultimately results in leakage of sensitive server information or code execution.
